Proves AR-6's `in` operator on a `string` field via AG Grid's native Set Filter wire shape (`{filterType:'set', values:[...]}`), case-insensitive membership by default (SEM-1) — compiled as a `term`-per-value disjunction on Search (the `terms` query has no `case_insensitive` option, unlike `term`/`wildcard`/`prefix`/`regexp`). Per SEM-1's pinned collation-vs-pattern-match split, Postgres compiles to `status COLLATE craticula_ci = ANY($1)`, never `ILIKE ANY(...)` (the same exact-match escaping trap `eq`/`neq` avoid), and Mongo carries a query-level `collation: {locale, strength: 2}` alongside the `$in` pipeline stage.
